'''Fushigi Yamada''' (Japanese: '''山田ふしぎ''' ''Yamada Fushigi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was born as '''Kyoko Yamada''' (Japanese: '''山田恭子''' ''Yamada Kyōko'') on November 11, 1959 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}.
